name: Csömör (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of blue, yellow and blue in the ratio 1:2:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Csömör: a quartered blue and yellow shield with reeds, a patriarchal cross, a bunch of grapes and a ploughshare.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
